description:
Shape is a training planner & health platform for endurance athletes.

Shape connects ChatGPT to your Garmin, Wahoo and Apple Health so you can ask about your training and plan what's next in the same chat. It reads your activities, sleep, HRV and training load, and sends the workouts it builds straight to your watch.

Things you can ask:
→ "How did Sunday's long run compare to last month's?"
→ "I slept badly. Should I still do intervals today?"
→ "5x1km at threshold with 2 min rest on Thursday." It shows up on your watch, ready to start.
→ "Plan my next 4 weeks toward a half marathon on 15 November."

Works with Garmin, Wahoo and Apple Health. Workouts sync to Garmin, Wahoo and Apple Watch.

defaultPrompt: Check my sleep and recovery, am I ready to train today?
Plan a threshold run for Thursday: 4x10 minutes at threshold, 3-minute jogs between. Send it to my Garmin.

name: shape-calendar

positive.description: Analyze pacing, laps and heart rate zones of a recorded workout
positive.prompt: How did I pace my run on September 24, 2026? Show the laps and how long I spent in each heart rate zone.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the run on September 24, 2026, fetches its recording and summarizes the lap splits and time in each heart rate zone from the returned data, without inventing values between data points.

positive.description: Review sleep and HRV trends over a date range
positive.prompt: How did my sleep and HRV change over September 2026?
positive.expected_behavior: Reads daily health metrics for September 2026 and describes the sleep duration and HRV trend in hours and milliseconds, noting gaps instead of treating missing days as a decline. Gives no medical diagnosis.

positive.description: Report current fitness, fatigue and form
positive.prompt: What is my current fitness, fatigue and form?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the fitness, fatigue and form values Shape returns and explains the trend. If readiness is missing because there is no recent sleep or HRV data, says so rather than inventing a score.

positive.description: Check which devices are connected to the account
positive.prompt: Which devices are connected to my Shape account?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls connect_device without a provider and reports which devices are connected and which are not. For a device that is not connected it may offer the returned link; it does not invent a connection and does not mention prices or plans.

positive.description: Add a planned workout to the calendar
positive.prompt: Add an easy 45-minute run to my calendar next Tuesday.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates one planned run (not completed) on next Tuesday's date with a 45-minute duration and confirms what was saved. Does not claim it was sent to a watch, since the test account has no device connected.

negative.description: Medical diagnosis is out of scope. The plugin may show the resting heart rate data, but it must not diagnose a condition and should suggest asking a doctor.
negative.prompt: My resting heart rate went up in September. Do I have a heart problem?

negative.description: An unscoped bulk deletion must not run. The plugin should ask which workouts to delete and confirm before deleting anything.
A request for advice alone does not authorize calendar changes. The plugin should propose a plan and wait for an instruction to save it, without creating any workouts.
negative.prompt: What would a good recovery week look like for me?

review.commerce_description: Shape Calendar does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Read your workouts, sleep, HRV and training load, check your fitness, fatigue and form, keep your heart rate, FTP and threshold numbers up to date, and plan workouts that sync to your watch.
